explanation: The English article on the Tajik war files it, in the infobox that heads the page, as part of "the post-Soviet conflicts and spillover of the Afghan Civil War (1992–1996)". That is the article’s own statement of what the war was part of, not a hatnote or a category: the Tajik opposition’s bases and much of its supply lay across the Afghan border during exactly these years. The claim is spillover, so the type is enabled and not caused; the article’s prose does not argue the Afghan war as the Tajik war’s origin, and neither does this edge.
